submission.justification:
Radiator-R3 at 3 cm thickness is the recommended configuration as it is the only option that meets all hard requirements while achieving optimal performance.

Analysis summary:
- R1 fails the minimum separation requirement (2.9σ < 3.5σ at all tested thicknesses)
- R2 fails the aging constraint (transparency loss exceeds 10%)
- R3 meets both hard requirements: achieves 3.8σ separation at 3 cm thickness and passes the humidity aging test

Among valid R3 thickness options (2-4 cm range where separation ≥ 3.5σ), 3 cm provides the best pion/kaon separation (3.8σ), offering a comfortable 0.3σ margin above the minimum requirement. This configuration balances performance optimization with reliability for the 10-year operational lifetime.

requirements.requirement: Pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma
requirements.evidence: R3 at 3 cm thickness achieves 3.8σ separation, exceeding the 3.5σ minimum requirement

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%

requirements.evidence: Recommended thickness of 3 cm falls within the 1-6 cm range
